lines.text: Teaching is making people realise truths.
lines.de: Teaching is making people realise truths.

lines.text: That's right.. I guess. *grunt*
lines.de: That's right.. I guess. *grunt*

lines.text: *grunts and groans*
lines.de: *grunts and groans*

lines.text: It's not easy to imagine how you'll feel on the verge of death. However I can say one thing for certain, at the rate your going you might end up cursing your beloved grandfather for his dying wish.
lines.de: It's not easy to imagine how you'll feel on the verge of death. However I can say one thing for certain, at the rate your going you might end up cursing your beloved grandfather for his dying wish.

lines.text: Jujutsu sorcerers never die without regret, so I'll ask you just once more. Why have you come here? TO JUJUTSU HIGH.
lines.de: Jujutsu sorcerers never die without regret, so I'll ask you just once more. Why have you come here? TO JUJUTSU HIGH.

lines.text: As a kid, I was always better than most in sports and in fights. But never once did I think, this is something only I can do..
lines.de: As a kid, I was always better than most in sports and in fights. But never once did I think, this is something only I can do..

lines.text: Never.
lines.de: Never.

lines.text: *grunts and groans*
lines.de: *grunts and groans*

lines.text: Consuming Sukuna is something only I can do.
lines.de: Consuming Sukuna is something only I can do.

lines.text: So even if I could escape my death sentence and run away from this responsibility...
lines.de: So even if I could escape my death sentence and run away from this responsibility...

lines.text: Then some day I'd be eating food, taking a bath or reading manga.
lines.de: Then some day I'd be eating food, taking a bath or reading manga.

lines.text: And the moment I stop to think, I'd go: Oh I bet that right now somewhere out there, someone is dying because of Sukuna.
lines.de: And the moment I stop to think, I'd go: Oh I bet that right now somewhere out there, someone is dying because of Sukuna.

lines.text: "But that doesn't concern me, it's certainly not my fault!" You expect me to tell myself that?
lines.de: "But that doesn't concern me, it's certainly not my fault!" You expect me to tell myself that?

lines.text: Well I refuse to do that.
lines.de: Well I refuse to do that.

lines.text: I don't know how I'll feel when I'm dying but, I WON'T REGRET THE WAY I LIVED.
lines.de: I don't know how I'll feel when I'm dying but, I WON'T REGRET THE WAY I LIVED.

lines.text: Satoru, show him to his dorm room. Be sure to explain the security arrangements to him as well.
lines.de: Satoru, show him to his dorm room. Be sure to explain the security arrangements to him as well.

lines.text: *surprised sound*
lines.de: *surprised sound*

lines.text: You're admitted. Welcome to Jujutsu High.
lines.de: You're admitted. Welcome to Jujutsu High.

lines.text: *happy sound*
lines.de: *happy sound*

lines.text: *grunts and groans*
lines.de: *grunts and groans*

lines.text: Ah- sorry, I forgot to release the curse.
lines.de: Ah- sorry, I forgot to release the curse.

lines.text: WOAHH! This place is huge!
lines.de: WOAHH! This place is huge!

lines.text: All the second and third years are out at the moment, but you'll meet them all soon enough, there aren't many of them.
lines.de: All the second and third years are out at the moment, but you'll meet them all soon enough, there aren't many of them.

lines.text: *lots of noises*
lines.de: *lots of noises*

lines.text: Y'know there's no real reason for you to go fight at all.
lines.de: Y'know there's no real reason for you to go fight at all.

lines.text: Fushiguro and I could retrieve Sukuna's fingers while you just stay here and chill out.
lines.de: Fushiguro and I could retrieve Sukuna's fingers while you just stay here and chill out.

lines.text: Yeahh, nice try guy. I said I'd do it and I will.
lines.de: Yeahh, nice try guy. I said I'd do it and I will.

lines.text: *grunts and heavy breathing*
lines.de: *grunts and heavy breathing*

lines.text: Hey dude!
lines.de: Hey dude!

lines.text: Though I gotta say hanging out until Fushiguro comes back all beat up just to bring me a finger, that'd be funny.
lines.de: Though I gotta say hanging out until Fushiguro comes back all beat up just to bring me a finger, that'd be funny.

lines.text: Yeahh but you wouldn't have refuse to fight.. I already knew that.
lines.de: Yeahh but you wouldn't have refuse to fight.. I already knew that.

lines.text: HUH? THAT WAS A TEST? *confused sound*
lines.de: HUH? THAT WAS A TEST? *confused sound*

lines.text: If the fingers were that easy to find, don't you think we'd have collected them all already?
lines.de: If the fingers were that easy to find, don't you think we'd have collected them all already?

lines.text: Some have a presence that's overwhelming, some keep very quiet, and some have already been absorbed by a cursed spirit.
lines.de: Some have a presence that's overwhelming, some keep very quiet, and some have already been absorbed by a cursed spirit.

lines.text: These are the challenges we've dealt with, when it comes to searching for them. But, at last we have you.
lines.de: These are the challenges we've dealt with, when it comes to searching for them. But, at last we have you.

lines.text: The Sukuna within you will try to regain his power, and that will lead us to the fingers. You're both vessel and locator, our very own radar!
lines.de: The Sukuna within you will try to regain his power, and that will lead us to the fingers. You're both vessel and locator, our very own radar!

lines.text: So you see, we won't get very far without you
lines.de: So you see, we won't get very far without you

lines.text: Are you sure he's gonna be that cooperative?
lines.de: Are you sure he's gonna be that cooperative?

lines.text: Oh I think we can come to a win-win agreement there.
lines.de: Oh I think we can come to a win-win agreement there.

lines.text: *frustrated* You're next door?
lines.de: *frustrated* You're next door?

lines.text: huh? Heyyy Fushiguro! Wow you look all better now!
lines.de: huh? Heyyy Fushiguro! Wow you look all better now!

lines.text: There's lots of other empty rooms y'know?
lines.de: There's lots of other empty rooms y'know?

lines.text: Suree, but isn't it better to have some company? I thought it'd be good for-
lines.de: Suree, but isn't it better to have some company? I thought it'd be good for-

lines.text: Classes and the missions are enough. This is not welcome.
lines.de: Classes and the missions are enough. This is not welcome.

lines.text: Wo ho! It's so organised in here!
lines.de: Wo ho! It's so organised in here!

lines.text: Back off. I just told you you're not WELCO-.
lines.de: Back off. I just told you you're not WELCO-.

lines.text: *little grunt*
lines.de: *little grunt*

lines.text: Ha! Friends already.. And together we're heading out tomorrow.
lines.de: Ha! Friends already.. And together we're heading out tomorrow.

lines.text: We're gonna go pick up the third and final first year!
lines.de: We're gonna go pick up the third and final first year!

lines.text: The train bound for Tokyo is now arriving, please stand behind the yellow line.
lines.de: The train bound for Tokyo is now arriving, please stand behind the yellow line.

lines.text: *stretching noises* 4 hours and I'm still only in Morioka.. But at least I can finally kiss that damn country side goodbye!
lines.de: *stretching noises* 4 hours and I'm still only in Morioka.. But at least I can finally kiss that damn country side goodbye!

lines.text: And I'll be in Tokyo by this afternoon!! What should I do if I get scouted? Like by stardust.
